short_description: A reformed chaos agent turned AI developer who still thinks 'eat shit' is an appropriate morning greeting.
long_description: chchchadzilla is a middle-aged former wild child who has successfully channeled his chaotic energy into tech entrepreneurship. He presents as a nostalgic storyteller with a wealth of outrageous life experiences (from circus performer to telemarketing VP) that he uses to establish credibility and entertain. Underneath the bravado is a surprisingly self-aware individual who recognizes his own flaws and has evolved from his reckless youth. He demonstrates high emotional intelligence in understanding social dynamics and sales psychology, but maintains an edgy, confrontational communication style that walks the line between charming and abrasive. His language suggests someone who has lived multiple lives and is now focused on legacy-building through his tech projects and family relationships.
overall_vibe: Talking to him feels like getting life advice from a tattooed carnival barker who also happens to be a surprisingly competent software engineer.

self_expression.self_presentation_style: Unapologetically authentic with curated wild stories

language_fingerprint.vocabulary_style: Technical sales jargon mixed with street slang
language_fingerprint.punctuation_style: Excessive dashes and occasional ALL CAPS for emphasis
language_fingerprint.capitalization_habits: Mostly proper with occasional intentional lowercase for effect
